books.name: The Robot Club
books.focus: have been · who · since · pick up · although

items.s: I ___ been a member of the school robot club for two years.
items.tip: Present perfect = have + been: something that started in the past and is still true.
items.say: I have been a member of the school robot club for two years.
items.ask: I blank been a member of the school robot club for two years.

items.s: The club is run by Mr Patel, ___ used to be an engineer.
items.tip: who is for people. After a comma we can't use that.
items.say: The club is run by Mr Patel, who used to be an engineer.
items.ask: The club is run by Mr Patel, blank used to be an engineer.

items.s: We've built five robots ___ September.
items.tip: since + a starting point (since September); for + a length of time (for two years).
items.say: We've built five robots since September.
items.ask: We've built five robots blank September.

items.s: Our newest robot can pick ___ rubbish in the playground.
items.tip: pick up = lift something from the ground.
items.say: Our newest robot can pick up rubbish in the playground.
items.ask: Our newest robot can pick blank rubbish in the playground.

items.s: ___ it is quite slow, it never misses a crisp packet.
items.tip: Although joins two ideas that surprise us together: slow, but never misses.
items.say: Although it is quite slow, it never misses a crisp packet.
items.ask: Blank it is quite slow, it never misses a crisp packet.

items.s: Last month, we took it to a competition ___ London.
items.tip: in + a city or country: in London, in Japan.
items.say: Last month, we took it to a competition in London.
items.ask: Last month, we took it to a competition blank London.

items.s: We didn't win, but the judges were very impressed ___ our design.
items.tip: impressed by (or with) something.
items.say: We didn't win, but the judges were very impressed by our design.
items.ask: We didn't win, but the judges were very impressed blank our design.

items.s: Next year, we want to build a robot that can water the plants ___ its own.
items.tip: on its own = without help. (by itself means the same.)
items.say: Next year, we want to build a robot that can water the plants on its own.
items.ask: Next year, we want to build a robot that can water the plants blank its own.

books.name: Volcano Day
books.focus: was given · out of · which · until · so … that

items.s: Last Friday was Science Day, and every class ___ given a project.
items.tip: Passive in the past: was + given (someone gave each class a project).
items.say: Last Friday was Science Day, and every class was given a project.
items.ask: Last Friday was Science Day, and every class blank given a project.

items.s: Ours was to make a volcano ___ of paper and glue.
items.tip: make something out of = use it as the material.
items.say: Ours was to make a volcano out of paper and glue.
items.ask: Ours was to make a volcano blank of paper and glue.

items.s: First, we built the shape around an empty bottle, ___ became the crater.
items.tip: which is for things. After a comma we can't use that.
items.say: First, we built the shape around an empty bottle, which became the crater.
items.ask: First, we built the shape around an empty bottle, blank became the crater.

items.s: The paint took ages to dry ___ it was so thick.
items.tip: because gives the reason: it took ages because it was thick.
items.say: The paint took ages to dry because it was so thick.
items.ask: The paint took ages to dry blank it was so thick.

items.s: When it was ready, we were ___ excited to wait for the teacher.
items.tip: too + adjective + to = so much that we couldn't: too excited to wait.
items.say: When it was ready, we were too excited to wait for the teacher.
items.ask: When it was ready, we were blank excited to wait for the teacher.

items.s: We poured in vinegar, but nothing happened ___ we added more baking soda.
items.tip: until = up to that moment, then it changed.
items.say: We poured in vinegar, but nothing happened until we added more baking soda.
items.ask: We poured in vinegar, but nothing happened blank we added more baking soda.

items.s: Then it foamed so much ___ it spilled onto the floor!
items.tip: so + adjective/much + that shows the result: so much that it spilled.
items.say: Then it foamed so much that it spilled onto the floor!
items.ask: Then it foamed so much blank it spilled onto the floor!

items.s: ___ we do it again next year, we'll use a bigger tray.
items.tip: If + present, will + verb: a real plan for the future.
items.say: If we do it again next year, we'll use a bigger tray.
items.ask: Blank we do it again next year, we'll use a bigger tray.

books.name: A Letter to a Pen Pal
books.focus: used to · each · when · where · what

items.s: Dear Sam, thanks ___ your letter.
items.tip: thanks for + the thing: thanks for your letter.
items.say: Dear Sam, thanks for your letter.
items.ask: Dear Sam, thanks blank your letter.

items.s: I ___ to have a dog too, but now we have two guinea pigs.
items.tip: used to + verb = something true in the past but not now.
items.say: I used to have a dog too, but now we have two guinea pigs.
items.ask: I blank to have a dog too, but now we have two guinea pigs.

items.s: They're called Pip and Squeak, and they live in a hutch ___ our garden.
items.tip: in our garden = inside the garden area.
items.say: They're called Pip and Squeak, and they live in a hutch in our garden.
items.ask: They're called Pip and Squeak, and they live in a hutch blank our garden.

items.s: ___ morning, I give them fresh hay and carrots.
items.tip: Each / Every morning = all the mornings, one by one.
items.say: Each morning, I give them fresh hay and carrots.
items.ask: Blank morning, I give them fresh hay and carrots.

items.s: They squeak loudly ___ they hear the fridge door.
items.tip: when = at the time that: they squeak when they hear it.
items.say: They squeak loudly when they hear the fridge door.
items.ask: They squeak loudly blank they hear the fridge door.

items.s: I think they've learned that the fridge is ___ the food is!
items.tip: where = the place: the fridge is where the food is.
items.say: I think they've learned that the fridge is where the food is!
items.ask: I think they've learned that the fridge is blank the food is!

items.s: My cousin is coming to stay ___ a few days next week.
items.tip: for + a length of time: for a few days, for a week.
items.say: My cousin is coming to stay for a few days next week.
items.ask: My cousin is coming to stay blank a few days next week.

items.s: Write back soon and tell me ___ your puppy is called!
items.tip: what + is called: tell me what it is called (no question order inside).
items.say: Write back soon and tell me what your puppy is called!
items.ask: Write back soon and tell me blank your puppy is called!
